trans-unit.source: Say, it's been a long while since we last swung by Euclid.
trans-unit.target: Say, it's been a long while since we last swung by Euclid.

trans-unit.source: Wonder if anything's changed. Wanna take a look around?
trans-unit.target: Wonder if anything's changed. Wanna take a look around?

trans-unit.source: Yeah, sure. I'd like to find a nice gift for little Ami, anyway.
trans-unit.target: Yeah, sure. I'd like to find a nice gift for little Ami, anyway.

trans-unit.source: In return for the doll? Don't worry about it, man. She was content just making the thing.
trans-unit.target: In return for the doll? Don't worry about it, man. She was content just making the thing.

trans-unit.source: But accepting it for nothing just doesn't seem right...
trans-unit.target: But accepting it for nothing just doesn't seem right...

trans-unit.source: I think your sentiments are plenty, myself.
trans-unit.target: I think your sentiments are plenty, myself.
